traditional: the Sun conjunct Jupiter: vitality, authority, and recognition fused with growth, fortune, and patronage. The two act as one and the combined significations are hard to separate.
modern: Identity meets optimism, expansion, and luck. Confidence to venture and a sense that the odds will cooperate. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of selfhood and growth is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Confidence and opportunity, with overextension as the standing risk.
shadow: Egotism and needing to be the center fused with excess and overreach, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.

readerCopy.summary: A wave of attention puts a leader or passion project center stage.
readerCopy.body: A wave of attention puts a leader or passion project center stage. Sun conjunct Jupiter can make visibility and expansion feed each other so quickly that public backing becomes a new level of responsibility before the person at the center has had time to adjust. More attention creates more expectation. Decide what the larger audience can actually receive now. A bigger platform is useful when the promise grows with the work, not faster than it.
